jobs.description:
Deine VisionWe are Bloomwell, the most exciting health tech scale up in medical cannabis. Our goal is to make access to therapy as simple as possible for patients. We bring medical cannabis into everyday life, digital, simple and patient centric. And we are growing fast.

That is why we need you, as Business Development Manager , to own the next stage of our growth and take Bloomwell beyond Germany. We are evaluating International markets and you lead the work of turning that opportunity into reality. You research possible markets, build the entry strategy, set up the right partnerships and structures, and make sure our launches actually succeed rather than just look good on paper. You work closely with management and take full ownership of your domain.
Deine Aufgaben
• Develop and drive market entry strategies for our international markets, tailored to the regulatory and competitive environment of each country
• Conduct in depth market research covering demand, competitors, pricing and regulatory requirements for medical cannabis and related health products
• Build a repeatable market entry playbook covering legal compliance, licensing, local partnerships and operational setup
• Identify, evaluate and negotiate with local partners such as distributors, pharmacies, clinics and logistics providers
• Own the business case and commercial plan for each market, including pricing, unit economics and growth levers
• Coordinate cross functional launch activities together with product, marketing, legal, regulatory and operations teams
• Navigate local regulatory and compliance requirements around medical cannabis and healthcare products in cooperation with legal and regulatory affairs
• Monitor performance after launch and adjust the strategy based on real market feedback
• Report progress, risks and recommendations directly to management
• Represent Bloomwell in negotiations and on market visits, with regular travel to our international markets

The position is initially limited to 18 months. This is in accordance with our internal governance and planning principles, under which we structure employment relationships for a defined period of time initially. If performance is as expected, there is generally the prospect of a long-term continuation of the employment relationship. A possible extension will be discussed well in advance of the end of the fixed-term period.

Dein Profil
• Proven experience leading or heavily driving international market expansion, including full ownership of a market launch from strategy to execution
• Experience in expanding businesses beyond German borders is a strong plus, with a solid understanding of the regulatory, cultural and commercial dynamics of these markets
• Solid understanding of the regulatory and licensing frameworks for medical cannabis in at least one international market, for example bodies such as the MHRA, EOF, FDA, DEA, Health Canada or the TGA, and the ability to quickly get up to speed on new ones
• Background in business development, strategy consulting, venture building or international growth roles
• Willingness to travel regularly
• Strong analytical skills, comfortable building business cases, market sizing models and unit economics
• Confident communicator who negotiates well and holds their own with stakeholders and international partners
• Entrepreneurial mindset, motivated by ambiguity and by building something from zero
• Structured and hands on working style, able to translate strategy into concrete execution
• Fluent English is essential for this role
• Genuine interest in the cannabis industry and health tech is a must, a background in healthcare, pharma or another regulated market is a nice plus

Warum wir?You get to actively shape things from day one, in a growing market, with flat hierarchies and real room to decide. No slow moving structures, just fast paths and an open culture where your ideas count.
This is what you can expect:
• Ownership from day one with a direct line to management
• Flexible working hours and hybrid work
• eGym Wellpass for health and fitness
• Job-Bike
• Fresh fruit, snacks and drinks in our Frankfurt office near the Messe
• Regular team events and a vibrant company culture

*We use the gender neutral abbreviation (m/w/d) to indicate that this position is open to all genders.

Über unsDie Bloomwell Group mit Sitz in Frankfurt zählt zu den führenden Unternehmen für medizinisches Cannabis in Europa. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2020 gestalten wir ein innovatives, digitales Cannabis-Ökosystem – mit dem klaren Ziel, die Versorgung von Patient:innen zu verbessern und die moderne Cannabistherapie voranzutreiben. Wir bilden die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette ab (mit Ausnahme des Anbaus) und setzen Maßstäbe in Telemedizin, eRezept-Lösungen, digitalen Zahlungswegen und datengestützter Forschung. Unsere Plattform bringt zehntausende Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen, Apotheken und Partner aus dem Großhandel jeden Monat digital zusammen – für eine neue Ära der evidenzbasierten Cannabistherapie.
Weitere Informationen unter: https://bloomwell.de/

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. The research group „Structure and Function of Molecular Machines“ headed by Prof. Dr. Hauke Hillen at the Institute of Cellular Biochemistry is inviting applications for a 

PhD Student (f/m/d)

- Molecular & structural biology of organellar gene expression -

About us

Our group is located at the University Medical Center Göttingen (UMG) and at the Max-Planck-Institute for Multidisciplinary Sciences in Göttingen, Germany. Our research is aimed at understanding the mechanisms of eukaryotic gene expression system, in particular those found in organelles (mitochondria and chloroplasts) or employed by viruses. To study these systems, we combine structural biology (single-particle cryo-electron microscopy, X-Ray crystallography and cryo-electron tomography) with biochemical, biophysical and cell biological approaches. For recent examples of our work, see PMID: 34489609, 34135319, 38428434, 39747487, 40050611 and 40240327.

We offer access to state-of-the art instrumentation for cryo-EM (including two 300 kV Titan Krios TEMs, a 200 kV Glacios TEM and two Aquilos 2 FIB-SEMs as well as correlative fluorescent and light microscopy devices), X-Ray crystallography and various modern biophysical techniques. Göttingen is a vibrant, international student town located in the center of Germany and, in addition to its university, is home to a number of renowned research institutes, which together form the Göttingen Research Campus.
 
Position details

The position is fixed term (3 years) and the salary will be in accordance to the German Public Sector Collective Agreement (TV-L). The position is to be filled as soon as possible. The UMG is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals. We further strive for gender and diversity equality. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.

How to apply

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. To apply, please submit a single PDF containing a short statement of motivation and previous experience, a CV, and the names and contacts of at least two references through the system. 

For more information, visit our lab website: http://hillenlab.uni-goettingen.de

Your tasks

· Combine cutting-edge structural biology, protein- and RNA biochemistry as well as cellular methods to dissect mitochondrial molecular biology from the atomic to the organellar scale
· Drive your own research project in a collaborative team with close mentoring and supervision
· Present & communicate research results at national and international scientific meetings
· Gain experience in mentoring and teaching of students

Your qualifications

· Applicants should hold a M.Sc. or equivalent degree in biochemistry or a related discipline
· Previous experience in structural biology, protein- or RNA biochemistry is advantageous
· Fluent English language skills (written and spoken) are required

We offer

· High-impact research field with biomedical relevance
· Small, international and diverse research group with a strong team spirit and an open-minded, collaborative and respectful working atmosphere
· Access to state-of-the-art infrastructure & hands-on training in latest methods in molecular biology and structural biology methods
· Structured cross-institutional graduate program that offers numerous mentoring and career support opportunities

For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Postdoc in FEL Physics

Limited: 2 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: MPO006/2026 | Deadline: 15.10.2026 | Full-time/Part‑time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

FLASH is DESY's (and the world's first) free-electron laser user facility. Within the FLASH2020+ project, the multi-beamline FEL facility FLASH has upgraded its primary arm, FLASH1, to accommodate the first externally seeded beamline, with a 1 MHz repetition rate in burst mode. We also adapt the diagnostics on both the photon and electron beam sides to match this goal. Stability is a key factor. A stable seeded source opens the door to many new experiments. Through the ErUM-Data and LEAPS-funded proposals, we develop resource-efficient and reliable Al and machine learning methods to advance ML for photon science applications while keeping large-scale research more sustainable. We are looking for a motivated postdoc to join the team and take an essential role in advancing the capabilities of FLASH with a focus on the externally seeded FLASH1 FEL branch.

About your role:

- Investigation of the coherent properties of undulator and FEL radiation with particular emphasis on transverse and spatial coherence
- Development of machine-learning-based methods to characterize (coherent) FEL radiation and deduce electron-beam properties using non-invasive single-shot photon diagnostics
- Enhance photon diagnostic capabilities, e.g. with respect to performance on ultrashort pulses
- Integration of the developed methods into the existing FLASH diagnostic infrastructure with the aim of providing non-invasive electron-beam diagnostics and supporting beam matching and optimization
- Support of FLASH operation and participation in dedicated experiments when appropriate
- Presentation of the achieved results in scientific journals and at international conferences

About you:

- PhD or equivalent, preferably with expertise in FEL physics, accelerator physics, or related field(s)
- Strong background in physics of coherent electromagnetic radiation
- Experience with machine-learning techniques and their application to partially or fully coherent x-ray sources
- Motivation to develop diagnostic methods, concepts, or instruments for the characterization of photon pulses
- Experience with Benchmarking theory against modeled or experimental data at light-source facilities as well as experience with numerical simulations using FEL and accelerator simulation tools (e.g. GENESIS, Elegant, or equivalent) are advantageous
- Good command of high-level scripting languages (Python/Matlab) is essential
- Good command of English
- Excellent teamwork abilities in an international environment

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work‑life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information, please contact Dr. Pardis Niknejadi at +49 40 8998‑5074 (https://tel:+494089985074) (pardis.niknejadi@desy.de (pardis.niknejadi@desy.de) ).

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation and research interests, CV, list of publications, relevant certificates and two letters of references). Please use our online tool for the submission of the letters of reference: Additional application documents (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/131690/2/892)

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Principal Business Development Manager CMTS Cell Line Development (x|f|m) to join our Emerging Business Unit CMTS home based in Europe at Sartorius Sartorius Stedim Biotech GmbH. In this role, you will be responsible for winning high value, strategically critical opportunities through consultative workflow design, regulatory and process influence, and innovation – driven differentiation, significantly shaping market direction and advancing portfolio growth in close collaboration with Central Sales.

You will be joining a newly created team, and we are looking forward to shaping the future with you. This position is available for full-time. It is a field-based role requiring (>50%) traveling to customers worldwide, with an initial focus on the EMEA region.

Grow With Us – Your Responsibilities

- Identify, pursue and win high‑value, complex strategic opportunities across key markets and accounts by uncovering unmet needs, latent demand, and innovation‑driven use cases 
- Design end‑to‑end workflows and advanced technical concepts that directly influence customer decision pathways, operational processes, and regulatory considerations
- Lead competitive differentiation and high‑stakes deal shaping by synthesizing deep technical, application, and market insights to construct compelling value‑creation narratives that maximize our win rate 
- Guide commercial strategy with Central Sales by defining technical and functional requirements that determine solution configuration, pricing logic, and deal construct for strategic opportunities 
- Shape the market and the portfolio by identifying trends, innovation points, and customer‑driven signals that influence product strategy, roadmap decisions, and market positioning 
- Drive early adoption and lighthouse success by embedding solutions into critical workflows, resolving escalated technical barriers, and enabling a seamless handover to Central Sales for scaling 
- Provide technical input to Central Sales, Business Unit stakeholders (e.g. PM, other BU Tech Sales roles) and Legal on the technical sections of contract terms and conditions to ensure technical feasibility, clear scope definition, reduced delivery risk, and alignment with customer workflows, without assuming commercial ownership

What Will Convince Us

- A Master’s degree in Life Sciences (e.g., Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Immunology, Genetics, Chemistry, Virology) forms the academic foundation for this role; a PhD is a plus
- Extensive professional years of experience in senior technical sales, workflow consulting, application support, or presales within a scientific or technical environment are essential
- Experience of new business development, growing and maintaining customers, develop and monitor sales pipeline
- A demonstrated hunter mindset with a strong track record of identifying, advancing, and winning new opportunities is expected
- Hands‑on technical expertise — including demos, trials, and customer evaluations — is a core part of the position
- Strong consultative communication skills enable clear articulation of both technical and commercial value to diverse stakeholders
- Proficiency in CRM systems and structured sales processes, combined with disciplined documentation practices is required
- Willingness to travel more than 50%, with a strong focus on external customer engagements, is integral to the role
- Business-fluent English is mandatory; German proficiency is an advantage

What We Offer

As a growing global life science company, stock listed on the MDAX and TecDAX, Sartorius offers a wide range of Benefits

- Personal and Professional Development: Mentoring, leadership programs, Talent Talks, internal seminar offerings , coaching for managers
- Work Life Balance: Remote options, flextime, flexible work schedules, sabbaticals, Workation
- Making An Impact Right From The Start: Comprehensive onboarding, including a virtual online platform even before joining, Welcome Workshops, "buddy" as point of contact
- Travel Benefits: Company car (ex. service, sales), car leasing, bike leasing, large free parking garage, good bus connections
- Welcoming Culture: Mutual support, teamspirit and international collaboration; communities on numerous topics, such as coaching, agile working and business women network
- Attractive Conditions: Company car including private use collective accident insurance, home office workplace and rent subsidy
- This position is filled within the Sartorius Stedim Biotech GmbH

We promote diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from people of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religions, age groups, disabilities, and cultural backgrounds.
